scenarios.title: SLO and error budget analysis
scenarios.description: Assess service level objectives and error budget consumption from approved reliability evidence, preserving missing observations and operator supplied targets.

scenarios.title: Backup and restore validation
scenarios.frequency: After an approved restore exercise or backup review
scenarios.description: Review backup evidence and completed restore exercises against recovery objectives without initiating a restore or treating a successful backup as proof of recoverability.

scenarios.title: Release regression detection
scenarios.frequency: After a release or reported regression
scenarios.description: Compare approved baseline and release observations to identify reliability regressions while distinguishing correlation from a confirmed release cause.

scenarios.title: AKS application incident triage
scenarios.description: Correlate application symptoms with approved Kubernetes workload evidence and propose bounded investigation steps without changing cluster resources.

scenarios.title: Messaging delivery failure triage
scenarios.frequency: During a delivery failure or backlog investigation
scenarios.description: Investigate approved messaging delivery observations, backlog and failure evidence without consuming, resubmitting or deleting messages.

scenarios.title: AI inference reliability investigation
scenarios.description: Review approved inference availability, latency and failure observations while separating service reliability evidence from model quality conclusions.
